# bitbucket_groups (Data Source)

Lists every group in the workspace.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "bitbucket_groups" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `groups` (Attributes List) Every group in the workspace. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--groups))
- `id` (String) Identifier (the workspace slug).

<a id="nestedatt--groups"></a>
### Nested Schema for `groups`

Read-Only:

- `auto_add` (Boolean) Whether new workspace members are automatically added to this group.
- `name` (String) Display name of the group.
- `permission` (String) Default repository permission granted to new members.
- `slug` (String) Slug of the group.
